newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia to privatise 80 pct of its ironworks.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia to privatise 80 pct of its ironworks.

text.p: The Slovenian government said on Thursday it would privatise 80 percent of its troubled ironworks Slovenske Zelezarne.
"We believe private ownership would help towards faster rehabilitation of the company," Minister of Economic Affairs Metod Dragonja told a news conference.
The privatisation still needs parliament's approval, he said, adding that privatisation was expected to start later this year.
The privatisation will encompass the public sale to domestic or international investors in the value of 60 percent of the firm and an employee buy-out of 20 percent of the company.
The ironworks had a loss of 1.4 billion tolars ($8.8 million) in the first quarter of 1997 after a loss of 1.2 billion in the same period of last year.
Sales eased to 13.6 billion tolars from 14.4 billion. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 158.5 Slovenian Tolars)
